title: Headset order with a Shenzhen supplier
scenario: Tom orders branded USB headsets from Wang Li, an export sales manager at a factory in Shenzhen. She speaks Mandarin with the English trade words common in export sales (logo, order, confirm, PI) and reads an email address the Chinese way ('艾特' for @, '点' for dot).

tom.name: Tom
tom.accent_note: Operations at a US startup, American English. Brian: deep American voice.

wang.name: Wang Li
wang.accent_note: Export sales manager in Shenzhen: Mandarin with English trade words. Jessica: warm American voice.

turns.speaker: wang
turns.text: Tom，你好！我是王丽。上周寄的样品，你们收到了吗？

ref.en: Hi Tom! This is Wang Li. Did you get the samples we sent last week?

turns.notes: #mixed #question #names #date only the name 'Tom' is in Latin letters

turns.speaker: tom
turns.text: Hi Wang Li. Yes, they arrived on Monday. The sound is great, but the cable is too short.

ref.zh: 王丽，你好。收到了，周一到的。音质很好，但是线太短了。
ref.en: Hi Wang Li. Yes, they arrived on Monday. The sound is great, but the cable is too short.

turns.speaker: wang
turns.text: 明白。线可以改成一米五，没问题。

ref.en: Understood. We can make the cable one and a half meters, no problem.

turns.speaker: tom
turns.text: Great. Can you also print our logo on them?

ref.zh: 太好了。能不能也把我们的logo印上去？
ref.en: Great. Can you also print our logo on them?

turns.speaker: wang
turns.text: 可以，logo每个加0.3美元，最少一千个。

ref.en: Yes, the logo is 30 cents extra per unit, with a minimum of one thousand units.

turns.speaker: tom
turns.text: OK. And the price for 2,000 units?

ref.zh: 好的。那两千个是什么价格？
ref.en: OK. And the price for 2,000 units?

turns.speaker: wang
turns.text: 嗯，那个……2000个的话，每个12美元，含运费。这个order你们什么时候能confirm？

ref.en: Um, well... for 2,000 units, it's 12 dollars each, shipping included. When can you confirm this order?

turns.notes: #filler #money #numbers #mixed #question '嗯，那个' = um, well; English 'order' and 'confirm' inside Mandarin

turns.speaker: tom
turns.text: This week, if you can ship before December 15th.

ref.zh: 如果你们能在12月15日前发货，我们这周就确认。
ref.en: This week, if you can ship before December 15th.

turns.notes: #overlap #date starts 0.3 s before Wang Li ends

turns.speaker: wang
turns.text: 我今天把PI发到你邮箱，tom艾特brightloop点io，对吧？

ref.en: I'll send the PI to your email today: tom@brightloop.io, right?

turns.notes: #email #mixed #question said the Chinese way: '艾特' = @, '点' = dot; PI = proforma invoice; same speaker after a pause
